arxiv.summary: LLM-driven autonomous agents are reshaping offensive security. However, in complex, long-horizon tasks, these agents frequently suffer from compounding errors and struggle to recover from failures. arxiv.summary: As automated decision-making and data-driven technologies pervade society and are used to manage consequential outcomes, understanding the technology's capabilities, limitations, and attendant risks in context requires analysis of full sociotechnical systems. arxiv.title: Towards a Unified Multidimensional Explainability Metric: Evaluating Trustworthiness in AI Models
arxiv.summary: In this paper, we present a comprehensive framework for assessing the explainability of various XAI methods, such as LIME and SHAP, across multiple datasets and machine learning models, with the ultimate goal of creating a unified multidimensional explainability score. Our methodology focuses on three key aspects of explainability: fidelity, simplicity, and stability. semantic_scholar.title: Failure as a Process: An Anatomy of CLI Coding Agent Trajectories
